notes.title: New level big centipede boss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310732/012cd2478f5c33f6407a4bcf12a807191ad02376.jpg[/img]ːsteamhappyː
       Update according to players' comments and questions, and add new content levels. Thank all players for their comments and suggestions!
Newly added big centipede boss: in troubled times, how many people are exposed in the wilderness. The big centipede eats a lot of dead bodies and tomb bodies that have not been collected, gradually grows larger, and begins to catch and eat the living people passing by!
A new level has been added, including skill introduction stone tablet, enemy tree demon and boss super centipede, to guide players to use skills and master the use of skills. In addition, the whole scene has been optimized to adjust the damage value more reasonably, and the scene is brighter and more realistic!
Drop [earth light] after the ghost dies to gain experience and increase level!
Players play the old witch in the cannibal inn. If they die unfortunately, they can resurrect in situ and challenge again. There is no need to start the game from scratch!
